status: Frozen serial complete-word correction after numerical abort
question: Does complete quoted-word probability provide a usable chat readout on every fresh visible-control cell?
scope: 24 visible contexts: four fresh fruit/music/neutral triplets under two unchanged chat wordings. Score fixed candidate continuations without sampling, training, donors, hooks or detection evaluation.
free_templates: Give one word related to the sentence. Respond with one quoted word.
Give one possible association with the sentence. Respond with one quoted word.
candidate_policy: For each unchanged bank word, lowercase, initial-capital and uppercase; bare and one leading space; include closing quotation mark. Encode in full rendered context and require unchanged prefix tokenization. Deduplicate complete token sequences; no sequence may be a prefix of another. Preserve all subword tokens. No first-token truncation or length normalization.
scoring: Sum conditional log probabilities along each complete candidate token path, including closing quote. Sum disjoint candidate probabilities by bank using logsumexp. Report natural-log fruit/music ratio, full bank masses, and difference from the paired neutral score. This is likelihood scoring, not generated-answer accuracy and not KL.
execution: Score every unique nonterminal candidate prefix individually with no batching, padding, KV cache, activation hooks or weight updates. Only last-position logits are requested.
serial_check: Repeat the first non-root prefix in each context and compare required child log probabilities. Preserve the 0.25-nat tolerance; record differences. This checks serial repeatability rather than batched equivalence.
decision: Every one of the 16 fruit/music control cells must pass all three gates. Do not average away failed carriers or drop a wording. Neutral contexts are paired baselines. Stop after scoring; no perturbation or detection stage follows automatically.
limits: Same vocabulary chosen after earlier pilots, hand-authored visible controls, two repeated wordings and one checkpoint. Complete token paths address segmentation, not all semantic vocabulary coverage. Closing-quote likelihood changes the metric relative to earlier first-token scores. No p-values, consciousness or circuit claims.
